subtopic: Virtual DOM Reconciliation and Fiber Tree Mechanics
question_text: [Modern UI Frameworks (React, Reconciliation, State) - Q42] Why does using array indices as `key` props in React lists cause rendering and state bugs during dynamic reordering or deletion?

options.text: Array indices cause memory leaks in JavaScript garbage collection
React matches Fiber nodes by key; when items shift positions, keys remain identical to indices, incorrectly preserving internal component state across mismatched items
Array keys disable virtual DOM diffing entirely

answer_explanation: React uses keys to identify stable identity across renders. When keys are indices, removing index 0 causes index 1 to inherit index 0's key, confusing uncontrolled inputs and local hook states.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: React uses keys to identify stable identity across renders. When keys are indices, removing index 0 causes index 1 to inherit index 0's key, confusing uncontrolled inputs and local hook states.
